item.title: Vantage Logistics taps Meridian Credit Partners for $450m private credit loan
item.description: Vantage Logistics has secured a $450m unitranche loan from Meridian Credit Partners, sidestepping the syndicated loan market.

item.title: Harbourline wraps Fund II fundraising at $1.75bn, doubling its predecessor
item.description: Harbourline Capital has wrapped up fundraising for Harbourline Senior Lending Fund II, hitting a $1.75bn hard cap.
